2608.03161.title: Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Knowledge Graph Construction for Multi-Lecture Educational Reasoning
2608.03161.paper_summary: Lecture videos distribute knowledge across speech, slide text, diagrams, equations, and presentation order, which transcript-only retrieval does not fully preserve. This paper presents an evidence-grounded multimodal pipeline that transcribes lectures, selects semantic anchors, applies optical character recognition (OCR), and uses a vision-language model to extract only concepts and typed relationships supported by transcript, OCR, or visual evidence. Mentions are validated and canonicalized into a provenance-rich knowledge graph. On three neural-network lectures, the pipeline processed 3,118 frames, 756 transcript segments, and 559 anchors. It retained 1,022 concept and 312 relationship mentions, yielding 172 canonical concepts and 282 relationships with 90.38% endpoint coverage. A preliminary three question retrieval test achieved 100% top-1 and top-3 accuracy and 100% mean top-5 recall. The contribution is an auditable construction method rather than a state-of-the-art performance claim.
2608.03161.paper_summary_zh: 講座視頻通過語音、幻燈片文本、圖表、方程式和演示順序分配知識，而僅僅依賴文字記錄的檢索並未完全保留這些內容。本文提出了一個基於證據的多模態流程，該流程轉錄講座、選擇語義錨點、應用光學字符識別（OCR），並使用視覺-語言模型僅提取由文字記錄、OCR或視覺證據支持的概念和類型關係。提及的內容經過驗證並標準化為一個富含來源的知識圖譜。在三個神經網絡講座中，該流程處理了3,118幀、756段文字記錄和559個錨點。它保留了1,022個概念和312個關係的提及，產生了172個標準概念和282個關係，端點覆蓋率達到90.38%。一項初步的三題檢索測試達到了100%的前1名和前3名準確率，以及100%的平均前5名召回率。這項貢獻是一種可審計的構建方法，而不是一個最先進的性能聲明。
